data.description:
As a maintainer, I want the two-tier flow (feature -> staged-* -> main) to fail RESILIENTLY -- distinguishing "couldn't compute" from "review violation," eliminating edge-case classes at the source, and self-healing the deterministic stalls -- so the flow stops collapsing every edge case into a hard block that needs manual git surgery, WITHOUT ever weakening the "every commit reaching main is reviewed" guarantee.

## SECURITY GUARDRAIL (non-negotiable, applies to every DD)
Resilience/self-healing apply ONLY to mechanical/indeterminate states (uncomputable diff, transient API error, stale-base version conflict, stale --resume state). They MUST NEVER auto-resolve "is this code reviewed" -- a genuine coverage/provenance violation stays a hard FAIL. Every DD states which class it handles and asserts it cannot flip a real review violation to PASS.

## Done Definition

- DD1 (Tristate gate contract): codify PASS / FAIL / INDETERMINATE in plugins/dso/hooks/lib/enforcement-gate-contract.md. FAIL = real violation -> block. INDETERMINATE = gate could not compute a verdict (precondition unmet, uncomputable/ambiguous diff, transient API error) -> bounded retry -> escalate; NEVER silently block or pass. Retrofit the review-coverage / dangling / llm-review-dispatch gates to emit the tristate. Generalizes story 1's (a85d) exit-78 mode-gating.

- DD2 (Version-bump KEEP -- resilience-hardening-plan SS9.5/SS9.6): retain ADR-0016's source-branch bump. Fix the stale-base version conflict with a PINNED feature-branch sync onto origin/main inside _phase_staged_intermediate (merge-to-main-pr.sh) BEFORE _phase_source_branch_version_bump, using the SAME origin/main SHA that _create_staged_ref used (no TOCTOU). Reuse _fetch_and_rebase_branch's abort-restore pattern; capture a pre-image patch BEFORE the rebase (always:patch-before-destructive); idempotent on --resume (skip when the feature is already pushed / PR1 exists -- never force-push a branch under in-flight review); never leave a duplicate staged-* ref on abort; build it as a first-class phase with its own _state_mark_complete key. Do NOT generalize _try_reset_stale_version_bump (it resets LOCAL main -- a different ref/safety property). Confirm direct mode needs no change (its _phase_sync merge likely already single-sides the bump) -> expect ci-pr-only. Leave marketplace.json untouched (its version/ref pin the stable channel by design; tag-release.sh owns it) + add a guard test that the bump path never writes marketplace.json. SECURITY: the version SHA rides PR1's review-sub-pr (plugin.json allowlisted -> skip-to-success) -> covered per-SHA like any commit; no coverage exemption, no bypass.

- DD3 (Durable-truth --resume): --resume reconstructs pipeline state from GitHub PR state + git history (level-triggered), treating /tmp/merge-to-main-state-*.json as a cache, not the source of truth. Eliminates the stale/cross-version state stall (INC-015). Builds on acb17a3cef.

- DD4 (Universal in-channel escalation): INDETERMINATE verdicts from any gate route to the existing /dso:fp-recovery escape valve so there is always an in-channel recovery rather than manual git surgery. (Optional stretch -- a level-triggered drift reconciler for ruleset <-> required-checks.txt parity + orphan staged-* pruning -- may split to its own story if it grows.)

- DD5 (Dangling-matcher correctness pass -- resolve the 6 llm-review findings on PR #631; COMPLETES story 29e7's sg matcher in plugins/dso/scripts/ci/check-dangling-references.sh):
  * [critical] _materialize_head_file (:147): the `>` redirect masks git-show failure -> files deleted/absent at HEAD materialize EMPTY -> sg reports zero refs -> false negatives (missed dangling refs). Detect git-show's exit code; on failure skip the symbol explicitly (or fail-closed), never silently treat as clean. Add error handling on the sg invocation (:160).
  * _defined_at_head shell-def regex (:129) + def-exclusion filters (:175 sg, :182 grep): match ONLY real shell definitions (`name() {` / `function name() {`); current `${sym}()` exclusion drops real Python 0-arg calls -> false negatives. Require `{` after `()`; keep the Python def/class exclusion.
  * _doc_references (:189): add `-w` to `git grep -F` -- substring matches (run_pipeline vs run_pipeline_v2) cause doc/config false positives.
  * DSO_DANGLING_MIN_LEN (:196): validate numeric before bash arithmetic (reject non-numeric env input).
  * sg detection (:67): align with centrality.sh:18-26's stricter `sg --version | grep -qE '^(sg|ast-grep) [0-9]'`.
  * Test harnesses (test-dangling-references-sg-matcher.sh, tests/scripts/measure-dangling-fp-fn.sh): isolate the git env (set HOME / GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL; sanitize); check git-op exit codes in _build_repo so a corrupted fixture fails loudly, not silently. RED tests reproduce the critical materialization false-negative AND the regex false-negative before the fix (GREEN after).

## Live verification + experiments
- Version-bump KEEP: branch off a stale main, let main advance V0->V1, run a real promotion -> the pinned feature-sync makes the PR1 version line single-sided -> clean merge, no manual rebase. Inject a CODE conflict during the sync -> clean abort + pre-image patch + INDETERMINATE/escalate, NOT a half-rebased branch or a duplicate staged-* ref.
- Dangling false-negative: the deleted-def / 4ba5-style fixtures that today false-NEGATIVE now correctly catch (or correctly skip with a logged INDETERMINATE), measured via measure-dangling-fp-fn.sh under an isolated git env.
- Indeterminate: force a token blip mid-coverage-walk -> gate emits INDETERMINATE -> bounded retry -> PASS (no wedge, no silent green).
- Security: attempt to launder an un-reviewed code change through every new path (KEEP version sync, INDETERMINATE retry, escalation) -> all still BLOCK. The guardrail holds.

## Course-correction trigger
If any resilience/self-healing path can be shown to flip a genuine review violation to PASS, STOP immediately -- revert that path to hard-block. Resilience is valid only while the guardrail holds.

## Dependencies / sequencing
- depends_on: a85d (S1, done -- DD1 generalizes its exit-78 mode-gating), 7b77 (S2 -- DD1 retrofits the coverage gate), 29e7 (S4 -- DD5 completes its matcher).
- blocks: 0cd7 (S5) -- its review-gate summary + exemption helper depend on DD1 (tristate) and DD2 (KEEP REMOVES S5's version-file coverage exemption; only the ticket-store exemption remains).
- relates_to: 4ba5 (bug -- empty-diff disambiguation; sibling prerequisite for DD1's llm-review-dispatch tristate; owned separately).
- CARVED OUT: the linear-history cutover (eliminate the merge-commit class via required_linear_history on the main ruleset) is a separate, ADR-0020-gated, deferred story (Story B), sequenced before story 7 (3ee4 enforce-flip). NOT in this story.
data.title: Resilience-harden two-tier flow: tristate gate contract + version-bump KEEP + durable --resume + dangling-matcher correctness
